method: Each NEXRAD Level-3 hail detection buffered 4 km and dissolved per size class. Detections belong to one local day (America/New_York); a day is built only after it has ended.
note: The radar over-detects. These are estimates of hail aloft over an area on a date. They are not a measurement of any roof.
